title: ShuffleNetV2 detects active tuberculosis on chest radiographs in a prospective cohort
summary: ShuffleNetV2 was trained on 4,613 radiographs from two centers and reached AUC 0.917 in a retrospective external cohort (1,318 patients) and 0.896 in a prospective cohort (560 patients). Performance was stable across demographic and scanner subgroups, and AI assistance raised radiologist AUCs to 0.897-0.937. The authors state that positive predictions should not be used alone to start treatment.
ai_technology: ShuffleNetV2 convolutional neural network on chest radiographs
